# Communication residue

Text meant for the reader, not addressed to the user who prompted it, must contain none of these.

## Chatbot framing
"Certainly!", "Of course!", "Great question", "Here's a…", "I hope this helps", "Let me know if you'd like…", "Feel free to…", "Would you like me to…".

## Self-reference
"As an AI language model", "As of my last knowledge update", "I don't have access to real-time data".

## Sycophancy
Praising the reader or the request ("What a fascinating topic"). Remove.

## Placeholders and template leftovers
`[Your Name]`, `[Company]`, `INSERT DATE`, `2025-XX-XX`, "Lorem ipsum". Fill or flag; never ship.

## Didactic disclaimers
"It's important to note that…", "Remember that…", "Always consult a professional" on content that doesn't need it.

## Meta-commentary
"This article will explore…", "In this section, we'll look at…". Just start.

## Edit-summary style
Change notes like "Improved clarity and flow, enhanced readability" describe nothing. State what changed: "Merged two duplicate paragraphs; fixed date of opening."
